exchanges: hi. long day. aisha has her learners test on saturday and shes a mess about it
That's normal before a first test. Has she been studying the handbook?
every night, she quizzes me at dinner and i realize i dont know half the rules myself lol
That's the funny part about those tests. You know the rules in practice, just not word for word.
true. my brother hamid said hed lend us his corolla so she can practise once she passes, mine is a stick shift and i dont want to deal with that
That's generous of him. An automatic is much easier to learn on.
yeah. omar is jealous obviously, hes 11 and thinks he should be allowed to drive too
Eleven-year-olds always think they're ready. Maybe he can be the navigator.
lol hed love that. hes got basketball tonight, coach mensah moved practice to the rec centre because the school gym is getting new floors
Good that they found a backup spot. Is it far for you?

no its closer actually. ok so heres a whole thing. my mom is having knee surgery next month, the replacement shes been putting off for like five years, and she always helps with pickups on thursdays so now i need to figure out thursdays, and on top of that my grandmother, so the kids great grandmother, is having cataract surgery the same week because of course she is, and my aunt wants me to drive her there because she doesnt do highways, so basically i need to be in three places at once
That's a lot landing in one week. It might help to list who needs to be where and when, and see which pieces someone else could cover.
yeah. fiona from omars team offered to take him on thursdays which helps
That's a big help. Good to have her on the team.
she is. her son kofi and omar are inseparable
That makes the carpool easy. They'll enjoy the extra time together.
lol yes. aisha also joined debate this year, shes actually really good
That's great. Debate might even help with test nerves.
ha maybe. her chem teacher ms duarte runs the debate club
Nice when it's a teacher she already knows. Does she like chemistry too?
not really, shes more into english and history. she wants to be a lawyer, shocking for a debate kid
Not shocking at all. Debate is good practice for that.
omar wants to be a youtuber which, no
A classic answer at eleven. It'll probably change ten times before high school.
lets hope. ok my mom just texted, surgery is the 14th
Okay, that gives you a date to plan around. Want to start with Thursdays?
yes. thursday pickup is 3:15 for omar and aisha takes the bus
So it's only Omar on Thursdays, and Fiona's covering that. That part is solved.
oh right it is. thats a relief
One down. Now it's just the drive for your grandmother.
my aunt said she'll take a taxi with her if i cant, so its not a disaster
That takes some pressure off. Still nice if you can manage it.
yeah ill try. also correction from before, my brother isnt lending the corolla, thats his wifes and she needs it. hes lending the civic
Okay, the other car then. As long as it's an automatic, Aisha's set.
it is. hamid is weirdly protective of it though, he just got it detailed
Aisha will have to treat it like gold then.
she will, shes careful. omar on the other hand spilled juice in my car twice this week
That's eleven for you. Maybe a no-drinks rule for a while.
good call. do you know anything about debate tournaments, ms duarte wants to take them to one in ottawa
They're usually a weekend of rounds with a lot of waiting around. It's a great experience if the cost works for you.
its like 200 bucks with the hotel
That's not bad for a weekend trip. Does the school help with fundraising?
theyre doing a bake sale lol
The classic. Every bit helps.
aisha said shell make her baklava, its actually incredible
Homemade baklava would sell out fast.
she learned from my mom so its legit
Learning from the source makes all the difference.
ok so my sister in law rania just called, she wants to bring her kids over sunday
Busy weekend then, with the test on Saturday. Are you up for it?
sure, the kids get along. her youngest has the flu though so well see
Hopefully the little one's better by Sunday.
yeah. omars coach just emailed, practice is cancelled tonight because of a staff thing at the rec centre
Surprise free evening then. Maybe a chance to rest before the busy week.
honestly i might just order pizza and do nothing
Sounds like the right call after the day you've had.
aisha wants to use the night to practise parallel parking with cones in the driveway lol
That's dedication. Cones make it feel like the real test.

questions.message: what kind of surgery is my grandmother getting again
what does aisha want to do when shes older
so aisha's gonna practise in hamid's corolla right
where's aisha doing her driving drills tonight
pizza and a quiet night honestly sounds perfect
